title: LocalFlow remote control message v1
description: UTF-8 JSON payload of a control frame (kind 0x00) after the hello on /v1/remote/channel (Feature 014), at most 65,536 bytes. Exactly one definition applies per type. Unknown fields are invalid_message; an unknown schema_version is unsupported_version. Byte bounds that JSON Schema cannot express (device name and term lengths in UTF-8 bytes, device key on the P-256 curve) are enforced by both implementations.

op.description: Client-chosen operation number, increasing within the channel, echoed in every reply.

term_text.description: 1 to 128 UTF-8 bytes; maxLength approximates the byte bound.

ready.description: Server: the hello was accepted; operations may start. capabilities is sent on session channels from Feature 018 on; without it the server serves dictation_start and rewrite only.

enroll.description: Client, purpose enroll, within 5 minutes of ready. signature is DER ECDSA P-256 over "localflow-v1-enroll" || binding.

device_name.description: At most 64 UTF-8 bytes after control characters are removed.

device_key.description: Secure Enclave P-256 public key, X9.63 uncompressed (65 bytes, first byte 0x04), base64url without padding.

signature.description: DER ECDSA signature, 8 to 72 bytes, base64url without padding.

enrolled.description: Server reply to enroll. state is the combined user and device state; a rejected user gets no refresh token.

refresh_token.description: lfr_ plus 32 random bytes, base64url without padding.

refresh.description: Client, purpose refresh. signature is DER ECDSA P-256 over "localflow-v1-refresh" || binding || SHA-256(refresh_token).

refresh_token.description: lfr_ plus 32 random bytes, base64url without padding.

tokens.description: Server reply to refresh: a new access token and the rotated refresh token.

access_token.description: lfa_ plus 32 random bytes, base64url without padding.

refresh_token.description: lfr_ plus 32 random bytes, base64url without padding.

dictation_start.description: Client, purpose session. boost is absent when the Dictionary is empty.

dictation_accepted.description: Server: the dictation was admitted. booster is absent when the server has no term booster.

window_result.description: Server: one recognized window, the wire form of TranscriptionWindow and RecognitionEvidence (FR-016).

progress.description: Server, at most every 500 ms while a window of the session is queued or running.

dictation_end.description: Client: no more audio. total_samples must equal the samples received.

dictation_complete.description: Server: every window_result of the dictation was sent.

rewrite.description: Client, purpose session: an unchanged rewrite request v1 or v2.

rewrite_event.description: Server: one event the HTTP route would have written as an NDJSON line.

model_identity.description: Engine identity of a meeting model (Feature 018). dimension is the voice embedding length.

capabilities.description: Feature 018 research R11: the session ops the server serves, built from its registered operations; meeting_jobs is empty and models absent while the meeting worker is unavailable.

start.description: Finite SDK timing in value, or a non-finite marker in invalid.

end.description: Finite SDK timing in value, or a non-finite marker in invalid.

analysis_part.description: Client: one fragment of the UTF-8 JSON analysis request (Feature 011), in order from index 0.

data.description: 1 to 49,152 UTF-8 bytes; maxLength approximates the byte bound (larger is limit_exceeded).

analysis.description: Client: closes the analysis request. parts, bytes and sha256 describe the assembled fragments; a mismatch is invalid_message.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the assembled UTF-8 bytes.

analysis_event_part.description: Server: one fragment of an analysis event line too large for one control message, in order from index 0.

data.description: 1 to 49,152 UTF-8 bytes; maxLength approximates the byte bound (larger is limit_exceeded).

analysis_event.description: Server: one analysis event (accepted, progress, result, error), inline in event or closing its analysis_event_part fragments with parts and sha256. The op ends after the result or error event.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the assembled UTF-8 bytes.

live_window.description: Client: one live-preview window; exactly sample_count s16le samples follow in 0x02 frames.

live_result.description: Server: the recognized live-preview window, in the window_result wire form.

meeting_job.description: Client: one meeting model call; exactly sample_count s16le samples follow in 0x02 frames. language, vocabulary_terms and pipeline are for transcribe only, num_speakers for diarize only.

meeting_progress.description: Server: the meeting job is queued (with its optional queue position) or running.

transcribe_result.description: TranscriptionWindow of a final-transcription window. timings_available is false when the model's timing was discarded (tokens then empty); retry_depth is the repetition-retry depth reached; language is the confident detection, if any; pipeline echoes the job's.

diarize_result.description: DiarizationWindowResult: turns in seconds from the window start and one L2-normalized centroid per cluster.

embed_result.description: VoiceEmbedding: the L2-normalized vector and the seconds of speech found in the region.

meeting_result.description: Server: the meeting job's result for its kind, the processing time and the model that produced it.

meeting_cancel.description: Client: drop the meeting job; the server deletes its samples and answers cancelled.

handoff_detail.description: failed, or receiving after a failed partial run (partial_failed): a short code such as exit_3, timeout or start_failed; never content.

handoff.description: Client: one meeting handoff request, answered by one handoff_reply (or error). put appends data at offset to the named file of a receiving meeting (creating the meeting) and, with sha256, checks the whole file; a put of rows.sqlite at offset 0 replaces that file. start queues a complete upload for processing, or with partial a run over the finished audio that returns the meeting to receiving; copy on put or start asks the server to keep the result for the owner's Mac. get reads the processed bundle.sqlite, or with name one AAC file, at offset; delete removes the meeting; release tells the server the sending device has its result (it deletes the meeting unless a Mac copy was asked for); list names the user's meetings; watch (the handoff_watch op) answers with a list of the meetings the calling device may import (another device's, copy, released, done) as soon as there is one, or an empty list after 10 minutes.

data.description: 1 to 48,000 bytes (base64url of 48,000 bytes is 64,000 characters); larger is limit_exceeded.

partial.description: start only: process the finished audio uploaded so far and return the meeting to receiving.

copy.description: put and start only: keep the processed meeting for the owner's Mac after release, at most 7 days.

handoff_reply.description: Server: the meeting's state after a handoff. put echoes name and the file's stored size in offset; get carries up to 48,000 bytes of bundle.sqlite (or the requested AAC file) from offset (data absent at the end) with the whole file's size and sha256; a list reply has meetings (at most 64) and no state.

data.description: 1 to 48,000 bytes (base64url of 48,000 bytes is 64,000 characters); larger is limit_exceeded.

progress.description: processing only: percent of the meeting's transcription and diarization done, as the processor last reported it.

transcribed_ms.description: receiving only, after a successful partial run: milliseconds of the meeting transcribed so far.

mine.description: The meeting's first put came from the calling device.

copy.description: The owner asked for a copy on their Mac.

released.description: The device that sent the meeting has its result.

error.description: Server. op is absent for hello errors. message is one fixed sentence per code, never derived from content.
